title: DataNet WC Review Checklist Hold v1
summary: Public checklist describing how a future reviewer may inspect DataNet availability work packets. This is checklist-only and does not perform packet intake, review approval, WC issuance, ledger mutation, VOID allocation, payment handling, signer access, wallet access, or runtime mutation.

checklist.title: Packet shape present
checklist.check: Confirm the packet follows the public DataNet WC available-work packet template shape.

checklist.title: Public-safe evidence only
checklist.check: Confirm the packet avoids private object material, private content roots, private object IDs, participant identifiers, reviewer identifiers, and operator identifiers.

checklist.title: Claimed capability clear
checklist.check: Confirm the packet states the claimed DataNet availability capability, such as serving or mirroring DataNet content.

checklist.title: Review window clear
checklist.check: Confirm the packet includes a public-safe review window or observation window description.

checklist.title: Duplicate claim precheck
checklist.check: Confirm a future reviewer would check whether the same claim was already evaluated before any later WC lane action is considered.

checklist.title: Hold boundary confirmed
checklist.check: Confirm the checklist result does not trigger packet intake, approval, WC issuance, ledger write, VOID allocation, payment handling, signer access, wallet access, runtime route creation, or mutation handling.
